findings_as_recorded.problem: src/i18n/bidi.ts isolates a sigil only when it opens a Latin word, so `$` + digit is not isolated. Measured with GNU FriBidi 1.0.16: the `$` resolves to the paragraph (RTL) level 1 while `0` sits at level 2, so the pair is drawn `0$`; reading the RTL line still yields `$0`, which is why the value reads correctly. UAX#9 W5 (ET adjacent to EN joins the number run) says a conformant engine - Chromium/ICU, i.e. the Electron surface - should draw `$0`. The two authorities disagree and the Electron surface was NOT exercised in this pass, so the painted result is unproven.
findings_as_recorded.suggestion: No copy change. Do not reorder the value or insert an LRM (the ur style guide forbids manual bidi controls and storage must stay logical). If a rendered capture shows `0$`, the fix belongs in isolateSigils (accept a digit after the sigil) with a regression test, i.e. a renderer ticket.
findings_as_recorded.disposition: recorded as information for rendered fit; does not gate this catalogue and does not affect the verdict
